joel.prompt: Square interpretive portrait of Joel, biblical prophet identified as Pethuel's son. Middle-aged man with dark beard, simple tan linen robe, muted green wrap, standing by a dry stone field wall, sparse bare fig branches behind him, solemn attentive face turned three-quarter left. Expressive oil sketch on matte canvas with ochre, gray-green and warm cream, evening light. No text, halo, date labels, modern objects, locust spectacle. Interpretive appearance, not verified.
